summary: Titanfall entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Titanfall 2
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC release, with official-server and Northstar state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current Windows PC build with documented server/client state

primary.why: The Windows version is the highest-fidelity capture route for the campaign and current multiplayer. Because the multiplayer history includes official servers and the community Northstar client, the archive should document which route is used.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam or EA PC build. Record storefront, build/date, graphics settings, campaign difficulty, official server state, multiplayer playlist availability, and whether Northstar was installed.

secondary.exclusive_content: Community-hosted custom servers, scripts, and mods
secondary.what_to_play: Use only for multiplayer preservation or modded-server documentation.
secondary.why: It is a community route rather than the official campaign/base-game route.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting console performance or player-base state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record whether the run uses the vanilla client or Northstar. Do not mix modded multiplayer state into the campaign route.
